description: Source code for FreeType CharMap cache implementation, including node management and cache lookup functions.

methods.name: ftc_cmap_node_new
methods.description: Initializes a new cmap node based on a query.

methods.name: ftc_cmap_node_weight
methods.description: Calculates the memory weight of a cmap node.

methods.name: ftc_cmap_node_compare
methods.description: Compares a cmap node with a query for cache management.

methods.name: ftc_cmap_node_remove_faceid
methods.description: Removes face ID from a cmap node if it matches.

methods.name: FTC_CMapCache_Lookup
methods.description: Looks up a glyph index for a character code in a specific face and cmap.
